from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BasicEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted Basic Earnings Per Share metric from a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the document (e.g. 'Basic Net Loss per share')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The reported Basic EPS value; negative indicates a loss")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this figure")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt anchoring the value and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[BasicEPSRecord]
